Definition: water; figuratively, juice; by euphemism, urine, semen
BiblicalUsage: Water is life and judgment and cleansing in the Bible, and the word runs through the whole story. The Spirit moves on the waters at creation, the sea stands as walls on either side at the Red Sea, and Moses strikes the rock and water comes out for a thirsty people. David is led beside still waters, and Isaiah calls everyone who thirsts to come to the waters and buy without money.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe water is the Bible's picture of what only God can give: no man makes a sea stand up, or draws water from a rock, or stills a soul beside quiet waters. The call to come to the waters is the gospel itself — life is free, but it is only found where God gives it. I hold that every well in the Bible is a signpost to Christ, who gives living water.
